name: Roots
pitch: A garden that remembers every bed, plant and harvest.
lead: A garden that remembers every bed, plant and harvest. Map your yard, plan each bed, and let the forecast tell you when to water.
features: Draw your real garden from above: beds, trees, sheds, fences and irrigation, each snapped to a quarter-foot grid. Tap a bed to see exactly what grows where inside it.
Set which way your yard faces, and Roots works out each bed's sun hours from the sun's path where you live and the shadows your own trees cast. Then it tells you which bed suits which plant.
Pick a plant, say how many and how far apart, and Arrange spaces them evenly across the bed. Nudge any plant by hand, then plant them one at a time or all at once.
Each week Roots checks the coming days' heat, humidity and rain, and works out which days each bed needs water and roughly how many gallons. Frost and heat alerts name the beds at risk.
Reminders that repeat like a calendar
Daily, weekly, every few days or any custom pattern, each linked to a bed or a single plant. A month calendar shows what's due, and a ticked reminder comes back on its next date.

Write notes about the whole garden, one bed or one plant, all in one searchable journal. Plantings, waterings, harvests and finished reminders add themselves, so the season's story is there without the typing.
Seasons, with a report at the end
Everything you do is tagged to its growing season. When a season ends, Roots writes a report: your total harvest, best crop, most productive bed, what went wrong and what to try next year.
Log each pick from the plant it came from, with weight, taste notes and up to 5 photos, at what it would have cost in the store. It all adds up by plant, bed, season and for good.
A score from 0 to 100 for your whole garden, built from yield, watering, care and sun fit. Insights adds a weekly harvest chart, ranks your beds and suggests what to do next.
data: Your garden lives on your phone. Daily Backup saves a copy to your own Google Drive, where only Roots can see the files it made.
Weather comes from your ZIP code, never your phone's location.
plans: Every feature on your phone, with no sign-in needed.
Buy once and keep it for good: a copy of your garden to your own Google Drive every day, at a time you pick, and whenever you ask.
Use Roots on your phone and tablet alike. A change on one shows on the others.
A new phone has your whole garden.
Connect your own AI app, so you can talk to it about your garden, have it make recommendations, and it makes changes only when you say so.
